7084-7272-7892.notablePrerequisites:

7084-7272-7892.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Thranduil the Strategist triggers, creating a 1/1 green Elf creature token
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

3259-5722-8201.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls no creatures.
Breath of Fury attached to a creature other than Wasitora.
3259-5722-8201.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent who controls no creatures using Wasitora and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Wasitora.
Resolve the Wasitora trigger, creating a 3/3 Cat Dragon creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Cat Dragon, then causing you to untap all creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat damage.

When the creature dies, Falkenrath Noble and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

Smaug triggers, creating two artifact tokens due to Jolene.

Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
When Metalwork Colossus enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Resolve the Shilgengar ability.

2060-4518-6930-7646.description:

Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.

Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Warden of the Eye and exiling Ephemerate.
When Warden of the Eye enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Warden of the Eye.
When Warden of the Eye enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Michelangelo.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Michelangelo.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 9 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

877-5400-6967.description:
Cast Synth Infiltrator by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Honest Rutstein.
Put Honest Rutstein into your graveyard due to the legend rule.

Honest Rutstein triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.

When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Virulent Emissary triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Repeat.

Activate Shuko's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Priest of Urabrask.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Priest of Urabrask.
The Shuko ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Priest of Urabrask from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Urabrask enters, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

Cast Glider Staff by paying {2}{W}.
When Glider Staff enters, it triggers, airbending Auriok Survivors
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Glider Staff, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Auriok Survivors from exile by paying {2}.
When Auriok Survivors enters, it triggers, returning Glider Staff from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2-877-6986.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {0}.
When Ancestral Statue enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.

You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
3470-4826-5702-6973.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Mutable Explorer.
When the Mutable Explorer token enters, it triggers, creating a Mutavault land token that enters untapped due to Archelos.
When the Mutavault token enters, Springheart Nantuko and Lotus Cobra trigger.
Holding priority, activate the Mutavault token by tapping it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Mutable Explorer.
Repeat from step 3.

586-5258-5618-6747-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Esika's Chariot.
When the Esika's Chariots enter the battlefield, their first abilities trigger, creating eight 2/2 Cat creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing three tokens, adding six {C}.
Repeat.

When the Robots enter the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

Activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.
When Bile Urchin dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Bile Urchin from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Bile Urchin ability.
Repeat.

413-2843-6553.easyPrerequisites: Unholy Indenture attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
413-2843-6553.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Unholy Indenture triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Brotherhood Outcast trigger, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

224-1993-5621.description:

When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Budoka Gardener.

1479-3756-6529.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3756-6529.description:
Play Izzet Boilerworks.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it, Curse of the Restless Dead, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Curse of the Restless Dead trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it and Curse of the Restless Dead trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

When Nardole dies, its undying ability triggers if it didn't have a +1/+1 counter, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if Nardole didn't have flying.
Resolve the undying trigger, if applicable, returning Nardole from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning Nardole from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if the creature is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

282-2034-2751-2905.notablePrerequisites: Delina does not have summoning sickness.
282-2034-2751-2905.description:
Declare Delina as an attacker, triggering its ability, targeting any creature.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Delina's trigger, with the copy targeting Pestermite.
Resolve the copy of Delina's trigger, creating at least one token copy of Pestermite.
When the Pestermite token(s) enter the battlefield, they trigger, untapping Strionic Resonator and up to one other applicable permanent for each remaining trigger.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Pestermite token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

An opponent cannot block creatures you control.

Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

575-2034-2348.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional nontoken creature.
575-2034-2348.description:

The creature dies, triggering Yedora, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land and as a 2/2 creature due to Nature's Revolt.
Repeat.

Pass the turn.
Repeat.
